chunks: That is why he has no friend today,
ai.seo_question: Who is the 'friend' (hamim) referred to in Surah Al-Haqqah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate futility of worldly alliances, illustrating that neither kinship nor political power can serve as a 'hamim' (close supporter) on the Day of Resurrection. It serves as a poignant reminder that true intercession belongs solely to Allah and the Prophet, leaving the individual entirely isolated without divine grace.
